questions.prompt: Which word is closest in meaning to courteous?
questions.explanation: Courteous means polite and considerate toward others.

questions.prompt: Which word is closest in meaning to immense?
questions.explanation: Immense means extremely large or vast.

questions.prompt: Which word is closest in meaning to perceive?
questions.explanation: To perceive something is to become aware of or notice it.

questions.prompt: Which word is most nearly opposite in meaning to broad?
questions.explanation: Broad means wide; narrow means having little width.

questions.prompt: Which word is most nearly opposite in meaning to inferior?
questions.explanation: Inferior means lower in quality or rank; superior means higher.

questions.prompt: Which word is most nearly opposite in meaning to innocent?
questions.explanation: Innocent means not responsible for wrongdoing; guilty means responsible.

questions.prompt: Rudder is to direction as thermostat is to ____.
questions.explanation: A rudder controls direction; a thermostat controls temperature.

questions.prompt: Gills are to fish as lungs are to ____.
questions.explanation: Gills enable a fish to breathe; lungs enable a mammal to breathe.

questions.prompt: Sapling is to tree as foal is to ____.
questions.explanation: A sapling is a young tree; a foal is a young horse.

questions.prompt: Which instrument belongs to a different measurement group?
questions.explanation: The other three measure length; a thermometer measures temperature.

questions.prompt: Which word belongs with whisper, murmur, and mutter?
questions.explanation: All four describe ways of speaking quietly or indistinctly.

questions.prompt: Which pair has the same relationship as chapter and book?
questions.explanation: A chapter is a division of a book; a scene is a division of a play.

questions.prompt: Every banner in the hall is blue or gold. No gold banner has stripes. Banner K has stripes. What must be true?
questions.explanation: K cannot be gold, and every banner is blue or gold, so K must be blue.

questions.prompt: Five talks—J, K, L, M, and N—are scheduled once each. L is immediately before M. J is first. N is last. K is before L. Which talk is third?
questions.explanation: J must be first and N fifth; the only arrangement fitting K before consecutive L and M is J, K, L, M, N.

questions.prompt: If the garden gate is open, the path light is on. The path light is off. What follows?

choices.C: The garden gate is not open.

questions.correctAnswer: The garden gate is not open.
questions.explanation: By the contrapositive, an off path light means the condition of an open gate is not present.

questions.prompt: Select the best answer. Which word is closest in meaning to meticulous?
questions.explanation: Meticulous means extremely careful and precise.

questions.prompt: Select the best answer. Which word is closest in meaning to reluctant?
questions.explanation: Reluctant means hesitant or unwilling.

questions.prompt: Select the best answer. Which word is closest in meaning to diminish?
questions.explanation: To diminish is to become or make smaller.

questions.prompt: Select the best answer. Which word is most nearly opposite in meaning to scarce?
questions.explanation: Scarce means limited; abundant means plentiful.

questions.prompt: Select the best answer. Which word is most nearly opposite in meaning to rigid?
questions.explanation: Rigid means stiff; flexible means able to bend.

questions.prompt: Select the best answer. Which word is most nearly opposite in meaning to conceal?
questions.explanation: To conceal is to hide; to reveal is to show.

questions.prompt: Select the best answer. Compass is to navigation as scale is to ____.
questions.explanation: A compass indicates direction for navigation; a scale indicates weight.

questions.prompt: Select the best answer. Hive is to bee as den is to ____.
questions.explanation: A hive shelters a bee; a den shelters a bear.

questions.prompt: Select the best answer. Pebble is to rock as drizzle is to ____.
questions.explanation: A pebble is a small rock; drizzle is light rain.

questions.prompt: Select the best answer. Which word does not belong with the others?
questions.explanation: The other three are shades of red; emerald is green.

questions.prompt: Select the best answer. Which item belongs with sonnet, ode, and haiku?
questions.explanation: All four are forms of poetry.

questions.prompt: Select the best answer. Which pair has the same relationship as lens and camera?
questions.explanation: A lens is a functional part of a camera; a key is a functional part of a piano.

questions.prompt: Select the best answer. All cedar boxes are wooden. No wooden object is transparent. What must be true of every cedar box?
questions.explanation: The two statements imply that cedar boxes cannot be transparent.

questions.prompt: Select the best answer. P, Q, R, and S each present once. Q presents immediately after P. R presents before P. S presents last. Who presents first?
questions.explanation: The only possible order is R, P, Q, S.

questions.prompt: Select the best answer. If the alarm is armed, the green light glows. The green light does not glow. Which conclusion is valid?
questions.explanation: The contrapositive shows that the alarm is not armed.

questions.prompt: Select the best answer. Which word is closest in meaning to resilient?
questions.explanation: Resilient means able to recover or adapt, so adaptable is the closest synonym.

questions.prompt: Select the best answer. Which word is closest in meaning to concise?
questions.explanation: Concise writing is brief while still expressing the needed idea.

questions.prompt: Select the best answer. Which word is closest in meaning to verify?
questions.explanation: To verify something is to confirm that it is accurate.

questions.prompt: Select the best answer. Which word is most nearly opposite in meaning to tranquil?
questions.explanation: Tranquil means calm; agitated expresses the opposite condition.

questions.prompt: Select the best answer. Which word is most nearly opposite in meaning to expand?
questions.explanation: To contract is to become smaller, the opposite of expand.

questions.prompt: Select the best answer. Which word is most nearly opposite in meaning to permanent?
questions.explanation: Temporary describes something that does not last permanently.

questions.prompt: Select the best answer. Wool is to sweater as clay is to ____.
questions.explanation: Wool is material made into a sweater, just as clay is material made into pottery.

questions.prompt: Select the best answer. Rehearsal is to performance as blueprint is to ____.
questions.explanation: A rehearsal plans and prepares a performance; a blueprint plans and guides a building.

questions.prompt: Select the best answer. Thirst is to water as fatigue is to ____.
questions.explanation: Water responds to thirst, while rest responds to fatigue.

questions.prompt: Select the best answer. Which word does not belong with the others?
questions.explanation: Bronze is an alloy, whereas copper, iron, and silver are elements.

questions.prompt: Select the best answer. Which item belongs with cedar, maple, and birch?
questions.explanation: Willow, like cedar, maple, and birch, is a type of tree.

questions.prompt: Select the best answer. Which pair has the same relationship as flock and birds?
questions.explanation: A flock is a group of birds, and a school is a group of fish.

questions.prompt: Select the best answer. Some lanterns are brass. Every brass object in the cabinet is polished. Which conclusion must be true?

choices.B: No polished object is a lantern.
choices.D: Some brass objects are not lanterns.

questions.explanation: The brass lanterns are polished because every brass object in the cabinet is polished.

questions.prompt: Select the best answer. A workshop offers pottery only on Monday or Thursday. Elena cannot attend Monday. If Elena attends pottery, when must she attend?
questions.explanation: Thursday is the only available pottery day Elena can attend.

questions.prompt: Select the best answer. Four folders—W, X, Y, and Z—are stacked. W is above X. Z is below Y but above W. Which folder must be on top?
questions.explanation: Y must be above Z, which is above W and X, so Y is on top.

questions.prompt: Which word is closest in meaning to "steadfast"?
questions.explanation: Steadfast describes someone firm and unwavering, so resolute is the closest synonym.

questions.prompt: Which word is closest in meaning to "arduous"?
questions.explanation: Arduous describes something requiring great effort, making demanding the closest synonym.

questions.prompt: Which word is closest in meaning to "recede"?
questions.explanation: To recede is to move back or away, which matches retreat.

questions.prompt: Which word is most nearly opposite in meaning to "lenient"?
questions.explanation: Lenient means permissive or not severe, while strict expresses the opposite quality.

questions.prompt: Which word is most nearly opposite in meaning to "chaotic"?
questions.explanation: Chaotic means disorganized or confused, while orderly means neatly arranged or controlled.

questions.prompt: Which word is most nearly opposite in meaning to "accelerate"?
questions.explanation: Accelerate means to increase speed, while decelerate means to decrease speed.

questions.prompt: Applause is to performance as laughter is to _____ .
questions.explanation: Applause is a common response to a performance, just as laughter is a common response to a joke.

questions.prompt: Key is to lock as password is to _____ .
questions.explanation: A key grants access through a lock, just as a password grants access to an account.

questions.prompt: Easel is to painter as lectern is to _____ .
questions.explanation: An easel supports a painter's working material, just as a lectern supports a speaker's notes.

questions.prompt: Which word does not belong with the others?
questions.explanation: Maple, cedar, and birch are trees, while a tulip is a flowering herbaceous plant.

questions.prompt: Which word belongs with waltz, tango, and foxtrot?
questions.explanation: A waltz, tango, foxtrot, and polka are recognized types of dance.

questions.prompt: Granite, marble, and slate belong to which group?
questions.explanation: Granite, marble, and slate are all types of rock.

questions.prompt: A workshop offers pottery only on Tuesday or Thursday. Photography is offered the day after pottery. If photography is offered on Friday, when is pottery offered?
questions.explanation: Photography occurs one day after pottery, so Friday photography requires Thursday pottery.

questions.prompt: Every bronze token is stamped. No stamped token is wooden. Which conclusion must be true?
questions.explanation: Every bronze token is stamped, and no stamped token can be wooden; therefore, no bronze token is wooden.

questions.prompt: Four folders—J, K, L, and M—are stacked. J is above L. M is below K but above J. Which folder must be on top?
questions.explanation: The constraints produce the order K, M, J, L, so K must be on top.
